trial_court: Family Court, Matrimonial Suit No. 47 of 2010
case_name: Sachindra Nath Prasad vs Sharda Devi @ Sharda Kumari
facts_of_case: The parties were in a matrimonial suit under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The appellant assailed an order of the Family Court dated 09.06.2020. The respondent had deserted the appellant without specifying the date of desertion.

legal_principles.principle: Desertion contention is not tenable for want of ingredients of Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.
legal_principles.held: In the absence of specific date, desertion contention is not tenable for want of ingredients of Section 13(1)(ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955.

legal_principles.principle: Appellant must apprise the court of specific date of desertion from the matrimonial by the respondent.
legal_principles.held: The appellant has not apprised the Family Court as to what is the date of desertion from the matrimonial by the respondent.
cited_cases: Sachindra Nath Prasad vs Sharda Devi @ Sharda Kumari, (2024)

outcome.final_order: The appeal was dismissed for want of material information.

use_for_drafting: drafting a divorce petition under Hindu Marriage Act
advising on desertion grounds in a divorce case
preparing a response to a divorce petition
